text.how_to_read: Tall spike = lots of stocks washed out at once. The biggest ones came at the big lows — but spikes also happen on ordinary dips.
text.right_now: At the close: Only 4% of stocks are scared — calm; SPY is at its record.
text.what_changes: Bigger candles smooth out the one-day spikes, so their numbers are lower — each has its own alarm line.

view.foot: Scared = a stock whose TET mood reading sits in its washed-out zone. Today’s S&P 500 members. Describes, doesn’t predict. Not advice.
